23void WiFiConnectivityDriver::connect() {
24 // Avoid re-triggering allocation requests if connection handshakes are actively executing
25 if (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED && !provisioningRequested) {
26 provisioningRequested = true;
27 WiFi.begin(networkSsidIdentifier, networkPasswordCredential);
28 }

31bool WiFiConnectivityDriver::isConnected() {

33 if (currentLinkStatus) {
34 provisioningRequested = false; // Reset volatile transit flag upon verified link auth
